selectors.exact: 41 percent of districts said they now require at least one classroom AI tool to run entirely on hardware the district owns or directly controls
selectors.prefix: In a survey conducted this spring,

body.value: Uncited statistic. This sentence reports a specific figure (41 percent) but names no survey and links to no source. Your lens asks for citation signals to be surfaced when they are absent.

basis.description: Absence signal: no hyperlink, named source, or reference pattern was found within this sentence or its containing paragraph. Detection is a heuristic (the engine scans a number-bearing sentence's paragraph for links and attribution phrases); a citation given elsewhere in the article, or a source the reporter had but did not name, would not be detected.

annotations.reasoning: The manifest lists 'citations' in requireProvenance, so the engine surfaces statistical claims that carry no detectable citation. This is a rule-based heuristic, not a verdict: the indicator says the citation signal is absent here, not that the figure is wrong (ADR-0007 - surface signals, never adjudicate truth).

body.value: A growing minority of U.S. school districts now run classroom AI models on hardware they own instead of in vendor clouds, citing control over student data; the Journal's own testing found local tutoring models within four points of leading cloud services. A vendor calls the tradeoffs solved, while district technology and budget officers describe unresolved maintenance and cost questions.

annotations.reasoning: The manifest sets presentation.summaries to 'brief', so the engine emits one document-level summary of at most two sentences. At the rule-based capability tier this summary is extractive: it is assembled from the lead sentences of the paragraphs that scored highest against the lens priorities, not generated by a model. The anchor status 'document' marks it as applying to the whole article rather than a span.

selectors.exact: Districts that stay on-device give up nothing. The tradeoffs people worry about simply are not there anymore.
selectors.prefix: said Tomas Reyes, the company's chief executive. "

body.value: An attributed counterpoint is available. 'Local AI Tradeoffs' (Consortium for Education Research, 2026) reports that on-device tutoring models still trail cloud models on multi-step reasoning tasks, and that maintenance, evaluation, and update burdens shift onto district staff - countering the vendor's claim that districts give up nothing.

basis.description: Attributed alternative source: 'Local AI Tradeoffs', Consortium for Education Research, 2026. The counter-argument presented above belongs to that source, not to the engine.

annotations.reasoning: presentation.counterpoints is set to 'on-request', so no counterpoint was rendered automatically; this annotation was produced only after the user requested counterpoints for this passage. The engine matched the vendor's no-tradeoffs claim against its index of attributed sources and retrieved one that argues otherwise. Per ADR-0007, a counterpoint is retrieval with attribution - the engine presents an existing source's argument and its URI, never an editorial rebuttal of its own.
